ICHIGO-DEFEND_ICHIGO.title: Defend
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_TENSHOU.title: Getsuga Tenshou
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_TENSHOU.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
{BankaiIcon}: Double damage and hits ALL enemies.
ICHIGO-STRIKE_ICHIGO.title: Strike
ICHIGO-DUAL_ZANGETSU.title: Dual Zangetsu
ICHIGO-DUAL_ZANGETSU.description: Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded Getsuga Tenshou|Getsuga Tenshou}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ICHIGO-FLASH_STEP.title: Flash Step
ICHIGO-FLASH_STEP.description:
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Getsuga Tenshou|Getsuga Tenshous}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
ICHIGO-SPIRITUAL_AWARENESS.title: Spiritual Awareness
ICHIGO-ENERGY_MANIPULATION.title: Energy Manipulation
ICHIGO-BRINGER_LIGHT.title: Bringer Light
ICHIGO-SONIDO.title: Sonido
ICHIGO-SONIDO.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. 
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ICHIGO-BANKAI_HOS.title: Bankai: Horn of Salvation
ICHIGO-BANKAI_HOS.description: Enter [gold]Bankai: Horn of Salvation[/gold] for [blue]{Turns:diff()}[/blue] turns. Deal bonus damage equal to percentage of missing HP.
ICHIGO-TRUE_BANKAI.title: True Bankai
ICHIGO-TRUE_BANKAI.description: Enter [gold]True Bankai[/gold] for [blue]{Turns:diff()}[/blue] turns. Double the effectiveness of [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] and heal HP lost from playing cards.
ICHIGO-FINAL_GETSUGA.title: Final Getsuga Tenshou
ICHIGO-FINAL_GETSUGA.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Upgrade and play|Play} all [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
ICHIGO-POWER_FUSION.title: Power Fusion
ICHIGO-POWER_FUSION.description:
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Add a [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] into your Hand for each card discarded.
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_INFUSION.title: Getsuga Infusion
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_INFUSION.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Getsuga[/gold] card this turn, gain 1 Strength.
ICHIGO-HOLLOWFICATION.title: Hollowfication
ICHIGO-HOLLOWFICATION.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. In [gold]True Bankai[/gold], heal that much instead.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ICHIGO-ARMOR_CLAD.title: Armor-Clad
ICHIGO-HYPER_SPEED_COMBAT.title: Hyper Speed Combat
ICHIGO-POWER_OF_VISORED.title: Power of Visored
ICHIGO-POWER_OF_VISORED.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. In [gold]True Bankai[/gold], heal that much instead.
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Gain {Reiryoku:diff()} [gold]Reiryoku[/gold].
ICHIGO-IRON_BODY.title: Iron Body
ICHIGO-SPIRIT_SURGE.title: Spirit Surge
ICHIGO-SPIRIT_SURGE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Cards:diff()} [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] to an enemy.
ICHIGO-BERSERK.title: Berserk
ICHIGO-BERSERK.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. In [gold]True Bankai[/gold], heal that much instead.
[gold]Attack[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] become [gold]Free[/gold] this turn.
ICHIGO-INNER_HOLLOW.title: Inner Hollow
ICHIGO-INNER_HOLLOW.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. In [gold]True Bankai[/gold], heal that much instead.
Gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
ICHIGO-ENHANCED_REFLEXES.title: Enhanced Reflexes
ICHIGO-ENHANCED_REFLEXES.description: Whenever you lose HP, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
ICHIGO-POWER_NULLIFICATION.title: Power Nullification
ICHIGO-POWER_NULLIFICATION.description: Your attacks deal double the bonus damage from [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] for {Turns:diff()} {Turns:plural:turn|turns}.
ICHIGO-TRUE_ZANGETSU.title: True Zangetsu
ICHIGO-TRUE_ZANGETSU.description: Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:, upgraded|}. All [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] cost 0 this combat.
ICHIGO-MASTER_SWORDSMAN.title: Master Swordsman
ICHIGO-CHANNEL.title: Channel
ICHIGO-BLOOD_CHAINS.title: Blood Chains
ICHIGO-BLOOD_CHAINS.description: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Bleed[/gold] on living enemies. ({CalculatedBlock:diff()})
ICHIGO-PINPOINT_SLASH.title: Pinpoint Slash
ICHIGO-PRECISE_CUT.title: Precise Cut
ICHIGO-PRECISE_CUT.description: Apply {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold] plus 1 for each [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] to an enemy.
ICHIGO-AURA_SHIELD.title: Aura Shield
ICHIGO-AURA_SHIELD.description: Gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain {GetsugaExhaustMultiplier:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each Getsuga Tenshou card in your [gold]Exhaust[/gold] pile.
ICHIGO-REIATSU_BARRIER.title: Reiatsu Barrier
ICHIGO-REIATSU_BARRIER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, take 50% damage from enemies with [gold]Bleed[/gold] or [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold].
ICHIGO-HOLLOW_GUARD.title: Hollow Guard
ICHIGO-SUBSTITUTE_SHINIGAMI.title: Substitute Shinigami
ICHIGO-SPIRIT_MASTERY.title: Spirit Mastery
ICHIGO-SPIRIT_MASTERY.description: Increase [gold]Strength[/gold] by 2 whenever you apply [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold].
ICHIGO-THE_RESOLVE_TO_KILL.title: The Resolve to Kill
ICHIGO-THE_RESOLVE_TO_KILL.description: For {Turns:diff()} turn(s): [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] cards gain [gold]Retain[/gold]. The first [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] you play each turn deals 6 additional damage.
ICHIGO-SHUNPO_MASTERY.title: Shunpo Mastery
ICHIGO-SHUNPO_MASTERY.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Getsuga[/gold] card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
ICHIGO-REIATSU_CLONE.title: Reiatsu Clone
ICHIGO-REIATSU_CLONE.description:
Your next attack is played twice. 
{BankaiIcon}: Your next 2 attacks are played twice.
ICHIGO-BANKAI_TENSA_ZANGETSU.title: Bankai: Tensa Zangetsu
ICHIGO-BANKAI_TENSA_ZANGETSU.description:
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] to your hand. 
Gain {Reiryoku:diff()} [gold]Reiryoku[/gold]. 
{BankaiIcon}: Extend [gold]Bankai[/gold] by 2 turns.
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_JUJISHO.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Getsuga[/gold] played this combat. 
{BankaiIcon}: Double additional damage.
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_JUJISHO.title: Getsuga Jujisho
ICHIGO-RISING_MOON.title: Rising Moon
ICHIGO-RISING_MOON.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Your next Attack costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. 
{BankaiIcon}: Your next Skill costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
ICHIGO-OVERSWING.title: Overswing
ICHIGO-MOON_FLASH.title: Moon Flash
ICHIGO-MOON_FLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Apply any debuffs on the enemy to ALL other enemies.
ICHIGO-ECLIPSE.title: Eclipse
ICHIGO-ECLIPSE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. 
Deal additional damage equal to {ExtraDamage:diff()}% of your missing HP. 
{BankaiIcon}: Double the additional damage.
ICHIGO-DUAL_CRESCENT.title: Dual Crescent
ICHIGO-DUAL_CRESCENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 2 times. 
{BankaiIcon}: Hit 2 additional times.
ICHIGO-BLACK_GETSUGA.title: Black Getsuga
ICHIGO-BLACK_GETSUGA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Double the enemy's [gold]Bleed[/gold]. 
{BankaiIcon}: Costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_PIERCE.title: Getsuga Pierce
ICHIGO-GETSUGA_PIERCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} if you've played [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] this turn. 
{BankaiIcon}: Trigger the enemy's [gold]Bleed[/gold].
ICHIGO-POINT_BLANK_GETSUGA.title: Point-Blank Getsuga
ICHIGO-POINT_BLANK_GETSUGA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Apply {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold]. 
{BankaiIcon}: Double the [gold]Bleed[/gold] applied.
ICHIGO-EXECUTE.title: Execute
ICHIGO-EXECUTE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. 
If the enemy has less than 50% HP, deal double damage.
ICHIGO-FRENZY.title: Frenzy
ICHIGO-FRENZY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
If you've lost HP this turn, hit an additional time.
ICHIGO-POISE_BREAK.title: Poise Break
ICHIGO-POISE_BREAK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Double the enemy's [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold].
ICHIGO-OPEN_WOUNDS.title: Open Wounds
ICHIGO-OPEN_WOUNDS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
If the enemy has [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold], apply {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold].
ICHIGO-OVERHEAD_STRIKE.title: Overhead Strike
ICHIGO-LUNGE_SLASH.title: Lunge Slash
ICHIGO-LUNGE_SLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
If the enemy has [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold], hit an additional time.
ICHIGO-STEADFAST_BLADE.title: Steadfast Blade
ICHIGO-STEADFAST_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Retain your hand this turn.
ICHIGO-FANG_SLASH.title: Fang Slash
ICHIGO-FANG_SLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {HitCount} times. 
Play a random Attack from your draw pile.
ICHIGO-HEAVENLY_FLASH.title: Heavenly Flash
ICHIGO-BRUTE_FORCE.title: Brute Force
ICHIGO-BRUTE_FORCE.description:
Lose 10% of your current HP. 
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage and additional damage equal to the HP lost.
ICHIGO-BARRAGE.title: Barrage
ICHIGO-BARRAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each Attack played this turn.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
ICHIGO-DEATHBLOW.title: Deathblow
ICHIGO-BLADE_DANCE.title: Blade Dance
ICHIGO-BLADE_DANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {HitCount:diff()} times. 
Costs 1 less for each Attack played this turn.
ICHIGO-FINAL_BLOW.title: Final Blow
ICHIGO-FINAL_BLOW.description:
Deal damage equal to the number of cards you've played this combat.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
ICHIGO-CERO_CRECIENTE.title: Cero Creciente
ICHIGO-CERO_CRECIENTE.description:
Lose 3 HP. 
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
{BankaiIcon}: Apply 2 [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] and 5 [gold]Bleed[/gold] to ALL enemies.
ICHIGO-REIATSU_EXPLOSION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} times. 
If you have more than 50 [gold]Reiryoku[/gold], increase X by 1.
ICHIGO-REIATSU_EXPLOSION.title: Reiatsu Explosion
ICHIGO-ARC_SLASH.title: Arc Slash
ICHIGO-ARC_SLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
If the enemy has [gold]Bleed[/gold], gain 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
ICHIGO-VORTEX_PULL.title: Vortex Pull
ICHIGO-VORTEX_PULL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Gain {Reiryoku:diff()} [gold]Reiryoku[/gold].
ICHIGO-DUAL_SWEEP.title: Dual Sweep
ICHIGO-DUAL_SWEEP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 2 times to ALL enemies. 
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ICHIGO-FULL_MOON.title: Full Moon
ICHIGO-FULL_MOON.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
{BankaiIcon}: If there is only 1 enemy, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
ICHIGO-GRAND_GETSUGA.title: Grand Getsuga
ICHIGO-GRAND_GETSUGA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each [gold]Getsuga[/gold] played this combat. 
{BankaiIcon}: Hits ALL enemies.
ICHIGO-FLYING_GETSUGA.title: Flying Getsuga
ICHIGO-FLYING_GETSUGA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
{BankaiIcon}: Play a random [gold]Getsuga[/gold] from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ICHIGO-NEW_MOON.title: New Moon
ICHIGO-NEW_MOON.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Add {IfUpgraded:show:an upgraded|a} [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. 
{BankaiIcon}: Add 2 additional [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold].
ICHIGO-BLACK_VOID.title: Black Void
ICHIGO-BLACK_VOID.description:
Lose 3 HP. 
Remove all of the enemy's [gold]Block[/gold]. 
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
